#### Issue body
The analysis below describes a profiling-state leak reproducible on current main.

> `torch.package.analyze.trace_dependencies()` installs its callback with `sys.setprofile()`, but always finishes with `sys.setprofile(None)`.
>
> If the caller already installed a profiling callback, that callback is lost after both successful tracing and exceptions.
>
> Expected behavior: preserve the callback returned by `sys.getprofile()` on entry and restore it from the existing `finally` block.
